name: a-pdlc-kit
description: Installs and maintains a four-level documentation discipline on a repository — AGENTS.md (how the repo is written), PRODUCT.md (what the product does and why, as delivered), adr/ (structural decisions, append-only), specs/ (a feature's decisions and rejected alternatives). Use when bootstrapping documentation on an existing codebase, or when building a feature whose decisions should be recorded.
